notes.subject: קרץ
notes.rationale: KJV 'destruction', JPS 'gadfly' (insect tormenting cattle), YLT 'rending' — hapax; 'gadfly' suits the heifer image.

notes.subject: ol birua i rausim olgeta
notes.rationale: קרץ literally 'extirpation by constriction'; rendered as agent-like phrase, losing the constriction picture.

notes.subject: בא בא
notes.rationale: Doubled verb 'comes, it comes' — urgency of approaching doom, kept by repetition.

translation: Mitsrayim em i olsem pikinini bulmakau meri, gutpela tru olgeta; tasol ol birua i rausim olgeta long hap nait, em i kamap, em i kamap tru.
